description: This Java class implements a metrics tracker for a database connection pool, specifically for monitoring HikariCP connection pool metrics in a Fineract tenant context. It tracks various connection metrics such as acquire time, total connections, idle connections, active connections, and creates corresponding Micrometer gauges, timers, and counters.

classes.name: TenantConnectionPoolMetricsTracker
classes.description: Implements the IMetricsTracker interface for tracking and exposing HikariCP connection pool metrics to Micrometer in the context of Apache Fineract tenants.

methods.name: TenantConnectionPoolMetricsTracker
methods.description: Constructor initializing various timers, gauges, and counters for tracking connection pool metrics, tagged by tenant and pool name.

methods.name: recordConnectionAcquiredNanos
methods.description: Records the time taken to acquire a connection in nanoseconds.

methods.name: recordConnectionUsageMillis
methods.description: Records the duration of connection usage in milliseconds.

methods.name: recordConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Increments the counter for connection timeouts.

methods.name: recordConnectionCreatedMillis
methods.description: Records the time taken to create a new connection in milliseconds.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Removes all metrics from the MeterRegistry, cleaning up resources.
